notes.zh: 评注：仅当玩家（非AI）修复远古星门（gateway_restored）、尚无人找到过这位客人、并通过20%的抽签时才出现（若曾激活或建造过星门，权重×4；银河门前起源×2），5天后弹出本窗口（common/megastructures/05_gateways.txt:433-476）。此时同时设下全局旗标 sharpbeak_recruit_phase，直到有人招募为止。
notes.en: Commentary: only when a player (not an AI) restores an ancient gateway (gateway_restored), no one has found this guest yet and a 20% draw succeeds (x4 weight if a gateway was reactivated or built before, x2 for the Galactic Doorstep origin); the window pops 5 days later (common/megastructures/05_gateways.txt:433-476). It also sets the global flag sharpbeak_recruit_phase, which stays until someone recruits him.

notes.zh: 评注：另一条入口——其他帝国（玩家或非集群）的舰队首次进入这座星门所在系统时触发隐藏事件 paragon.3901，15–30天后弹出；之后同样走向 paragon.3002（events/paragon_events_3.txt:3332-3401）。
notes.en: Commentary: the other entrance — when a fleet of another empire (player or non-gestalt) first enters the gateway system, hidden event paragon.3901 fires and this window pops 15–30 days later; it then leads to paragon.3002 as well (events/paragon_events_3.txt:3332-3401).

notes.zh: 评注：选项“招募”设下 skrand_recruited，清除招募阶段旗标，并在3600天后启动斯克兰德事件脉冲（paragon.3095）；“解散”则重新打开招募阶段，让别的帝国有机会（events/paragon_events_3.txt:425-520）。
notes.en: Commentary: the hire option sets skrand_recruited, clears the recruit-phase flag and starts the Skrand pulse (paragon.3095) after 3600 days; dismissing re-opens the recruit phase so another empire may take him (events/paragon_events_3.txt:425-520).

scope.zh: 入口（星门/相遇）、事件脉冲、全部后续事件的触发条件与各情势都已核对。
scope.en: The entrances (gateway / encounter), the event pulse, every follow-up event's trigger and all situations were checked.

uncertain: Whether the engine redraws the pulse when the drawn event's trigger fails (not visible in script).
The exact winning/losing conditions inside the Feather Rot sickness and cure situations (situation progress rates) were not simulated.
